results.content: President Trump’s approval rating has remained stagnant at the lowest point between his two presidencies, according to a new poll. The latest Reuters/Ipsos survey shows that Trump’s approval rating has remained at 33 percent — the third time the pollsters have found this result — amid the unpopularity of the Iran war and rising prices. The same poll found that 71 percent of respondents said they do not approve of Trump’s handling of the cost of living, which has become one of the top issues for voters during this primary election season and beyond.
